guide.titleLead: "I don't just show you Sri Lanka.
guide.titleAccent: I introduce you to its heartbeat."
guide.lead: I am {name}. For over {years} years, I have opened the hidden sanctuaries, ancient monolithic kingdoms, and fragrant spice highlands of my homeland to world wanderers seeking far more than just standard tour buses.
guide.leadNoYears: I am {name}. For many years, I have opened the hidden sanctuaries, ancient monolithic kingdoms, and fragrant spice highlands of my homeland to world wanderers seeking far more than just standard tour buses.
guide.body: Holding the highest National Tourist Guide Lecturer license issued by the Sri Lanka Tourism Development Authority (SLTDA), I specialize in strictly private, custom itineraries where your curiosity sets the day's tempo.

private.title: 100% Private & Flexible
private.body: Pace your morning. Stop at roadside king coconut stands or secluded viewpoints without rigid deadlines.

access.title: Insider Access
access.body: Private blessings at Buddhist forest hermitages, colonial arrack tastings, and quiet wildlife corridors.

fleet.title: VIP Fleet Comfort
fleet.body: Toyota Prado luxury SUV & VIP Royal Lounge vans, onboard 5G Wi-Fi, chilled Ceylon towels & refreshments.

categories.title: Choose Your Island Horizon
categories.intro: Every category can be blended seamlessly into an interconnected, multi-week voyage tailored to your precise physical and cultural preferences.

featured.title: Signature Private Itineraries
featured.intro: Every journey is privately executed, totally customizable, and hosted exclusively by me. No fixed dates, no shared strangers.
featured.notice: Every journey here is designed personally, never sold off the shelf. I personally review every request to confirm seasonality, villa availability, and VIP transit permits before your personalized proposal is finalized.
featured.emptyBody: My signature itineraries are being refreshed. Tell me what you dream of and I will design it around you.

craft.title: How I Craft Your Journey
craft.quote: "Tell me what moves you—wildlife dawn drives, secret ruins, or lazy ocean afternoons—and I will assemble the pieces."

share.title: Share Your Intentions & Timing
share.body: Select your travel window, party dynamics, physical activity preferences, and architectural villa desires via my inquiry form or direct WhatsApp line.

blueprint.title: Receive Your Tailored Blueprint (24h)
blueprint.body: I personally construct an hour-by-hour routing proposal, vetted boutique stays, and wildlife activity windows. We refine it together until it is perfect.

arrive.title: Arrive & Savor Flawless Ease
arrive.body: From your VIP Bandaranaike Airport greeting to your last southern sunset, I personally ensure complete security, quiet comfort, and authentic wonder.

destinations.title: Iconic Ceylon Encounters
destinations.intro: Hover over each sanctuary to preview its unique geographic temperament and cultural significance.

corporate.title: Corporate Retreats, Executive Incentives & Dignitary Escorts
corporate.intro: I deliver flawless turnkey ground handling for multinational boards, embassy VIPs, and corporate retreats seeking inspiring island environments.

estates.title: Private Heritage Estate Buyouts
estates.body: Exclusive private hire of Ceylon tea bungalows and coastal design villas for strategy sessions.

fleet.title: Premium Executive Fleet Transit
fleet.body: Luxury Toyota Coaster executive coaches and convoy Prado SUVs with dedicated baggage escorts.

liaison.title: 24/7 On-Ground Diplomatic Liaison
liaison.body: Single point of contact, bilingual interpretation, airport tarmac permits, and tailored dietary catering.

reviews.title: Guest reviews
reviews.emptyBody: Guest reflections will appear here soon.

responsible.title: Travel Smart, Tread Lightly
responsible.intro: I hold an unyielding commitment to preserve Sri Lanka's fragile ecosystems and support indigenous communities. Every expedition directly enriches local artisans, avoids mass commercial tourist mills, and adheres to strict ethical wildlife interaction protocols.

plastic.title: Zero Single-Use Plastic
plastic.body: Complimentary personalized double-walled stainless steel insulated flasks in my vehicles.

equity.title: Community Direct Equity
equity.body: Fair compensation paid directly to village cooks, local trackers, and cultural artisans.

safari.title: Ethical Safari Standard
safari.body: Strict engine-off protocols, respectful wildlife distances, and no off-road habitat destruction.

faq.emptyBody: Have a question about visas, seasons or etiquette? Ask me directly — I reply personally.

climate.title: Ceylon Climate & Seasonality Matrix
climate.intro: A quick reference guide for picking the perfect regional pairing for your desired departure window.

southWest.name: South & West Coast
southWest.body: Mirissa, Galle, Bentota, Colombo. Peak blue skies, calm ocean surf, and whale migrations.

eastNorth.name: East Coast & North
eastNorth.body: Trincomalee, Pasikuda, Jaffna. Glorious dry warmth, crystal snorkeling, and dolphin pods.

highlands.name: Central Tea Highlands
highlands.body: Nuwara Eliya, Ella, Hatton. Crisper mountain temperatures (15°C–22°C), misty peaks, and roaring tea waterfalls.
